feat: add sessionExpiration to addSessionToUser (#19046)

`addSessionToUser` and `extendSession` take an optional
`sessionExpiration`, so a session can last longer than its token.
`addSessionToUser` also returns the session it created, and extending a
session never shortens it.

Nothing in Payload starts longer sessions yet. Refresh tokens (#19040)
will: their sessions last 30 days by default while each token still
expires after `tokenExpiration`.
